name: The eleven stages of the lay follower (Śvetāmbara canonical list)

stages.name: darśana-pratimā
stages.description: flawless right faith, free of doubt and wrong views

stages.name: vrata-pratimā
stages.description: the five small vows and the supplementary vows kept without transgression

stages.name: pauṣadha-pratimā
stages.description: fasting and living like a monk on the holy days of the lunar fortnight

stages.name: kāyotsarga (niyama) pratimā
stages.description: abandoning the body in standing meditation through the night of the holy days (moderate confidence)

stages.name: ārambha-tyāga
stages.description: not initiating harmful household or business undertakings oneself

stages.name: preṣya-tyāga
stages.description: not having such undertakings done by servants or others

stages.name: uddiṣṭa-tyāga
stages.description: not accepting food prepared specially for oneself

stages.name: śramaṇa-bhūta
stages.description: living like a mendicant (shaved or plucked, with the monk's equipment, begging alms) while still a layperson

notes: Each stage is traditionally held for an increasing number of months (one month for the first, two for the second, and so on; moderate confidence). Continues into mendicant initiation and the guṇasthānas (pth:jain-fourteen-gunasthanas). Compare U35's pth:jain-eleven-pratimas.

name: From lay follower to naked monk (Digambara ladder)

stages.name: darśana-pratimā
stages.description: right faith with the eight basic restraints

stages.name: rātri-bhukti-tyāga
stages.gloss: renouncing night-eating (in some lists: chastity by day)

stages.name: uddiṣṭa-tyāga (kṣullaka, then ailaka)
stages.description: the kṣullaka keeps two cloths and a bowl; the ailaka a single loincloth, eating from the hand; women may become kṣullikās and āryikās

stages.name: muni-dīkṣā
stages.description: taking the twenty-eight root qualities; thereafter the ascent through the sixth and seventh guṇasthānas

notes: Stage names follow the Ratnakaraṇḍa Śrāvakācāra (moderate confidence on the sixth); stage 12 links to pth:jain-fourteen-gunasthanas.
